# Acme Corp — Master Services Agreement

**Vendor:** Acme Corp
**Effective:** 2025-01-01

## Payment terms
Net-30. Acme invoices **quarterly** at **$50,000 per quarter** for platform
services. Total annual commitment: **$200,000**. Late payments accrue 1.5%
monthly interest.

## Termination
Either party may terminate with 60 days written notice.
